desc: team network device Netlink interface tool
r: teamnl — team network device Netlink interface tool

teamnl is a tool enabling interaction with a team device via the team driver Netlink interface. This tools serves mainly for debugging purposes. Note that it makes no sense to use this tool to change options on team device controlled by a teamd instance.

-h, --help
Print help text to console and exit.
-p ifname, --port_name ifname
Select per-port option of provided interface name.
-a index, --array_index index
Select array option of provided array index.

ports
Dumps team ports.
option
Dumps team options.
getoption opt_name
Gets option by selected name.
setoption opt_name opt_value
Sets option by selected name.
monitor opt_style
Monitors changes made to options, ports and interface information. Style can be either "changed" (default) or "all".
Jiri Pirko is the original author and current maintainer of libteam.
